coverage_boundary: Immediate accessible evaluation-results packages with public-result, result-v or heldout-result in their directory name, or an immediate public-result.json file; immediate files only. No private root is inferred for unmatched declarations.

relationship_semantics.joins_existing_positions: Source positions are already included in the named saved census; this edge adds no observations or votes.
relationship_semantics.excluded_ancestor: The source is excluded as an independent additive population. QPC24 v2/v3 retain both edges because their accepted contributions are inherited by the saved join, while their ancestor populations are not added again. The incomplete control-r2 excluded attempt has no joined-position edge.
